reviewBasis: Dev-context steering: 'No heavy ceremony for data protection. Self-review is acceptable for pre-production gate closure.'
scopeReviewed: 3.1 SQLiteVectorStore exact cosine 384d MiniLM partition contract
3.2 FTS5 full-corpus search and offline floor
3.3 Graph, temporal, and active-goal retrieval strategies
3.4 Deterministic query classifier and versioned adaptive RRF
3.5 Gates, diversity, token packing, and exact trace finalization

findings.description: V-RET-03 full 200+ judged query live run not yet executed. Metric functions (recall@10, nDCG@10, identifier/phrase, exclusion) are implemented and unit-tested in kria-eval::memory_graph::retrieval_eval. Full execution requires CMD-MG-EVAL binary against 100k fixture set.
findings.disposition: Documented as NBW-F3-01/F3-03. Planned for F5.

verdictRationale: All retrieval sub-tasks (3.1–3.5) implemented. Policy prefiltering, exact cosine scoring, FTS5 parameterized queries, graph traversal authorization, RRF fusion, and diversity/packing gates all verified by passing tests. Heavy live run deferred to F5 per execution contract.
plannedFollowUp: V-RET-03 full live run at F5 with CMD-MG-EVAL 100k fixture
